profile.name: USB通信端口组件
profile.description: 用于实验系统中通过USB与外部设备交换数据的非物理通信组件。它提供设备枚举、端口打开与关闭、缓冲区查询与清空、字节读写以及字符串读取等基础通信能力，用于承载上层仪器协议。
profile.description_en: A non-physical communication component used in laboratory systems to exchange data with external devices over USB. It provides basic functions for device enumeration, opening and closing a port, checking and flushing buffers, reading and writing bytes, and reading strings, serving as a transport layer for higher-level instrument protocols.

registry.name: Open Standard USB Port
registry.description: USB Port是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、打开、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, allDevices等操作。
